description: Erection of a rear dormer; raising the ridge of the front main roof involving a front extension at second floor level; insertion of rooflights to the front and rear roof slope
decision_conditions: <p>All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.</p><p>REASON: To conserve the character of the host dwelling.</p>

<div>Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details and full specifications of 2 swift bricks shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and shall be maintained for the lifespan of the development. The details should include:</div><div><ul><li style="margin-left: 15px;">A minimum of 2 swift bricks incorporated into the design of the development. They should be installed in groups of at least 2, and placed at or close to eaves level of the development hereby approved. They should be placed at least 5m above the ground with a 5m unobstructed flight path, both below and in front of the swift brick. The swift brick should be located facing north, east, or north east (direct sunlight should be avoided) and should not be placed immediately above doors or windows. Where possible, swift bricks should be set flush into the external wall to match adjacent brickwork.</li></ul></div><div>REASON: To support bird populations, including swifts, in Hackney and preserve endangered urban biodiversity, by providing nesting opportunities, in accordance with Hackney’s Local Plan LP33 policy LP47 which states that all development schemes involving buildings with an eaves height or roof commencement height of 5 metres and above are required to provide nesting boxes for swifts, sparrows, starlings, and/or bats as appropriate.</div>
